notes.description: what the director sees in the cut as a whole, chapter by chapter; short

intent.description: the plan's intent, or a corrected one

intentReason.description: why the intent changed; empty when unchanged

card.description: a candidate card of the intent, or presenter-plain / footage-plate / title-hero-over-photo

why.description: one sentence: why this shot looks and moves like this

motifState.description: the motif's state when this beat is a motif appearance in the brief; empty otherwise

callbackFrom.description: the beat this shot pays off when it is a callback target in the brief; empty otherwise

treatment.description: the treatment ladder in prompts/visual-director.md: evidence first, metaphor last

evidence.description: real pictures to find through the materials step (never generated, never file paths)

what.description: what the picture shows (Chinese, one sentence)

entity.description: person / company / product / place name; empty when none

form.description: what form the real picture takes: photo, video footage, a web page (news report, official page: captured and archived), a paper page or figure, a logo, a market / data chart, the author's own screen recording

noEvidence.description: why a beat with facts on it shows no real picture; empty otherwise

scenes.description: cuts inside the beat (montage); empty for one cut

recall.description: an earlier beat id whose shot this cut replays (recap / callback montage), empty for none

fixes.description: which problem this revision fixes (a sequence issue, a rhythm target, a weak still, a line the picture misses), in one sentence

stage3d.description: hero-3d only (null on every other card): the engine template and its params (a JSON object written as text); every number shown is in facts

params.description: the template params as JSON object text, e.g. {"value":"8000","unit":"万"}

diagram.description: morph-chapter only (null on every other card): how the continuous diagram shows this beat

form.description: 2d: a flat diagram; 2.5d: flat figures laid on a table the camera moves over (letters, grids, strips, trees); 3d: an object with volume that turns (a helix, a chromosome, a model); map: the real map plane

figure.description: the kit figure or object that carries the beat: helix / seq / dots / tree / map / own (and what it shows)

camera.description: the camera through the beat in words: from where to where, close or wide, when it pushes in

keys.description: the camera as numbers, a JSON array text: [{"at":0,"dist":9,"elev":10,"azim":-35,"dur":0,"look":"the helix's middle"}, ...] in beat-local seconds (dist in scene units, elev/azim in degrees, dur seconds to arrive, look in words); "[]" for a flat 2d diagram

reads.description: what the viewer has to understand in this beat, in order: each read its own span of beat-local seconds, at least 0.8 s, never two at once, all inside the beat

what.description: what the viewer understands (Chinese, a few words)
